playstyle: Up-close pressure and rushdown with great counter-hit tools. Poke from range with d+3 and df+3, catch presses with safe counter-hit launchers (df+4, b+4), and flow into Morondava (MOR) and Bao (BAO) stances. Wavu warns her backdash is one of the worst and getting in can be risky, so earn your way in with safe pokes.

stances.name: Morondava
stances.entry: F after df+4 and other moves
stances.note: MOR.1,2 is a Heat Engager; MOR.2 follows f,f,F+2,1~F (Wavu).

stances.name: Bao
stances.entry: 4,4 and u+4 transition automatically; F after some combos
stances.note: BAO.3 is a Heat Engager; BAO.4 tornadoes in her BnB.

keyMoves: Fast check; 1,1,2 is her i10 punish (Wavu).
